verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Anytype exposes a local API, MCP server, and an 'agents skill' letting external agents run one-off scripts against Anytype data, but nothing describes any built-in scheduler, cron-like trigger, or recurring/automated workflow execution within Anytype itself. Automation-depth is a fair axis for an AI-native knowledge tool, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
